tinyfiledialogs v2.9.3 [July 12, 2017]

Upstream: http://tinyfiledialogs.sourceforge.net
          git://git.code.sf.net/p/tinyfiledialogs/code

Vendored as plain source (tinyfiledialogs.c/.h), the same way external/spout2
and external/syphon are, rather than through a package manager - it is two
files with no build system and no dependencies.

Compiled into the Linux build only (LINUX_SOURCES in CMakeLists.txt). It backs
every Platform:: file dialog and ShowFatalError's message box on Linux by
shelling out to zenity / kdialog / yad / qarma / matedialog; see
src/platform/linux/PlatformLinux.cpp.

Unmodified from upstream. Licence: zlib (see LICENSE in this directory).
